title: Regulations to Curb Use of Telegram for Illicit and Criminal Activities
what_it_is: Regulations to Curb Use of Telegram for Illicit and Criminal Activities

sections.label: Online Criminal Harms Act powers
sections.summary: The Government relies on Online Criminal Harms Act legal powers to issue Directions preventing online criminal content from interacting with users in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To address this, the Government primarily relies on the legal powers under the Online Criminal Harms Act (OCHA).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: When online criminal content is detected, the Government can issue OCHA Directions to prevent the offending accounts or content from interacting with users in Singapore.

sections.label: OCHA Codes of Practice measures
sections.summary: Under the OCHA Codes of Practice, designated online services like Telegram must implement systems to disrupt malicious accounts, and Police are working with providers on further anti-scam measures this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Through the OCHA Codes of Practice, designated online services, such as Telegram, must implement appropriate systems, processes and measures to quickly disrupt malicious accounts and activities and prevent their propagation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: As part of the continuing efforts against the serious crime situation, the Police are working with designated online service providers, including Telegram, to implement further anti-scam measures under the OCHA Codes of Practice by this year.

sections.label: Telegram anonymity and scam offers
sections.summary: Telegram users can remain anonymous, and follow-ups through the Central Narcotics Bureau found many offers to sell drugs or sexual offers are scams masquerading as those offers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: One of the key traits of Telegram is that users can remain anonymous.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: And for Telegram, I think when we last spoke about this during the Committee of Supply, I also mentioned that we have followed up, for example, I personally have followed up on some of these text messages that I have received on Telegram purportedly selling drugs, for example.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: And when we followed it up through the Central Narcotics Bureau, we realised that actually many of these offers to sell drugs, even sexual offers, are actually scams masquerading as those offers.

sections.label: First quarter numbers trend
sections.summary: In the first quarter of this year, the numbers have continued that trend, and the speaker is slightly heartened.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: In the first quarter of this year, the numbers have continued that trend; we are slightly heartened.

sections.label: Further anti-scam measures coming
sections.summary: Further anti-scam measures are coming out later this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: Like I mentioned earlier, further anti-scam measures are coming out later this year.
